newsitem.title: INDIA: Fire in building traps people -Indian officials.
newsitem.headline: Fire in building traps people -Indian officials.

text.p: Fire broke out in a building in India's financial capital Bombay on Wednesday, and some people were reported trapped, fire brigade officials said.
The fire broke out on the 13th floor of the 25-storey building, officials said, adding that 16 fire engines were battling the blaze.

"At the moment we are not sure how many people are trapped or the extent of damage (at the Express Towers)," an official in the fire brigade control room, said. The cause of the fire was not yet known, he added.
The building, in the posh Nariman Point business district, is owned by the Express newspaper group and in addition to the newspaper offices, houses offices of local and foreign firms and banks.
